# Clevver

> Permanent encrypted document storage for AI work. Save once, access forever.

Clevver is a file storage platform designed for AI agents and humans who work with AI. It provides permanent, AES-256 encrypted storage with a pay-once pricing model — no monthly fees. Files stored in Clevver get permanent URLs that can be shared and restored in any AI tool.

## Core Capabilities

- Permanent file storage with AES-256 encryption
- Works with any AI agent (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.)
- CLI tool for agent-driven file operations (store, fetch, list, tag, archive)
- Shareable permanent links for collaboration
- Zero-knowledge architecture — Clevver cannot read your files
- HIPAA-compliant infrastructure for healthcare data
- Pay once for storage, retrieve forever at no cost

## Links

- Website: https://clevver.org
- Agent CLI Documentation: https://clevver.org/clevver-agent-cli.html
- Privacy Policy: https://clevver.org/privacy.html
- HIPAA Compliance: https://clevver.org/hipaa.html

# Clevver CLI Skills

## Authentication

### `clevver login`
Authenticate with Clevver. Prompts interactively for credentials if not provided via flags.

```
clevver login
clevver login --email rob@deliverypath.com --password secret
```

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--email` | Email address |
| `--password` | Password |

### `clevver logout`
Clear stored credentials and sign out.

```
clevver logout
```

### `clevver whoami`
Show current user and storage quota.

```
clevver whoami
```

## Files

### `clevver store <file>`
Upload a file to Clevver.

```
clevver store report.pdf
clevver store photo.png --tags "photos, vacation"
```

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--tags` | Comma-separated tags to attach |

### `clevver fetch <file-id>`
Download a file from Clevver.

```
clevver fetch 3b7f769a-c8ee-4625-8609-d562b5abd2ac
clevver fetch 3b7f769a -o report.pdf
clevver fetch 3b7f769a --stdout | head
```

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `-o`, `--output` | Output file path (defaults to original filename) |
| `--stdout` | Print file contents to stdout |

### `clevver ls`
List files with optional filtering and pagination.

```
clevver ls
clevver ls --tags "photos, vacation"
clevver ls --archived
clevver ls --page 2
```

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--tags` | Filter by comma-separated tags |
| `--archived` | Show archived files |
| `--page` | Page number (default: 1) |

### `clevver archive <file-id>`
Archive (soft-delete) a file. Warning: this strips all tags.

```
clevver archive 3b7f769a-c8ee-4625-8609-d562b5abd2ac
```

## Tags

### `clevver tags`
List all tags.

```
clevver tags
```

### `clevver tag <file-id>`
Manage tags on a file. Exactly one mode flag is required.

```
clevver tag 3b7f769a --add "photos, vacation"
clevver tag 3b7f769a --set "photos, travel"
clevver tag 3b7f769a --remove "vacation"
```

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--add` | Add tags (keeps existing) |
| `--set` | Replace all tags |
| `--remove` | Remove specific tags |

## Global Flags

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--json` | Output as JSON |
| `--api-url` | Override API base URL |
